ANIMATED HOME
CR 11

XP 12,800
N Colossal construct
Init -4, Senses blindsense 90 ft., Perception +20

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 2, flat-footed 16 (-4 Dex, -4 size, +14 natural)
hp 400 (torso) 100 (limbs)
Fort +15, Ref +4, Will +8
Immune construct traits
Space 60 ft., Reach 40 ft.

OFFENSE

Speed 50
Melee 2 slams +22 (2d12 +10) This attack hits a 5-foot radius rather than a single target.

STATISTICS

Str 30, Dex 2, Con -, Int -, Wis 12, Cha 10
Base Atk +8; CMB +14 (+18 grapple), CMD 24 (28 grapple)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Modular (Ex)

The house is made of several pieces, each granting it increased power.

Leg. Each leg grants the house +20. move s peed.
Arm. Each arm grants the house as lam attack.
Head. The head control s the house’s blindsense
Torso. If the tors o is destroyed, the house dies.

Every part of the house has the same AC. If a piece (other than the tors o) is destroyed, the tors o suffers 50 damage.

Hostile Environment (Ex)

Creatures inside the house are tos s ed a bout and crushed by the objects flying a bout. Every round, creatures inside suffer 4d6 bludgeoning damage.

Creatures are granted a DC 15 Reflex save to cut the damage in half.

Golem’s Heart (Ex)

The table in room 1 is now throbbing heavily, and the surrounding wood pulsates as its ends power to the limbs. If attacked, the heart has an AC of 10. Every point of damage dealt to the heart is multiplied by 5 and dealt to the torso.

Crush (Ex)

As a standard action, the house falls, causing 10d6 crushing damage to itself and creatures in a 30-foot radius. Creatures inside are granted a Reflex save DC 18 to negate the damage.

ABOUT

The lizardfolk will only accept the results of the challenge if Sszarn informs them of it. Killing him, even legitimately, will not make an alliance.
